description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.
 
 Help Shape the Future of Cancer Care  
  
 We are looking for a Software Engineer with a strong algorithm development or scientific background to join our Eclipse development team. In this role, you will contribute to the development of advanced radiotherapy treatment planning technology used by clinicians around the world. 
  
 You will work on algorithms, optimization methods, and software development for the Eclipse Treatment Planning System. The position offers the opportunity to solve challenging problems at the intersection of medical physics, mathematics, optimization, and software engineering while contributing to products that help improve cancer treatment. 
  
 We are primarily looking for someone with strong experience in algorithm development who enjoys tackling complex technical challenges and collaborating on innovative solutions.
  
 We value technical excellence, but attitude is equally important.
  
 This opportunity could be for you if you are someone who:
  
 Enjoy taking ownership and getting things done
 Are humble, collaborative, and eager to learn
 Have a positive, "let's solve it together" mindset
 Enjoy working closely with colleagues and sharing knowledge across disciplines
  
 We recognize that talent comes from many different paths and encourage you to apply, even if your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed. If you are excited about this role and believe you could contribute, we would love to hear from you.
  
 Your role: 
   
 Develop and improve radiotherapy treatment planning algorithms. 
 Research, design, and implement new algorithmic solutions, modeling modern radiotherapy delivery devices. 
 Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, from concept and design to implementation, testing, and delivery. 
 Collaborate closely with software engineers, physicists, researchers, and quality engineers in an agile development environment. 
 Support product releases by helping where needed and working collaboratively across team boundaries. 
 Contribute to technical discussions, innovation activities, and continuous improvement of our treatment planning solutions. 
  
 Your expertise: 
   
 MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 Strong programming skills in C++ essential.
 Solid understanding of algorithms, numerical methods, optimization, or scientific computing. 
 Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 Fluency in English language, both written and spoken.  
   
 Desirable Skills & Experience: 
   
 Experience with medical imaging, radiotherapy, medical device software, or other regulated software environments. 
 Experience with CUDA / GPU programming.
 Experience with Monte Carlo algorithms. 
 Experience with C#, .NET and WPF. Experience in scientific research and publication activities. 
  
 What We Can Offer  
  
 Inspiring work atmosphere with supporting work community. 
 Meaningful work with the medical domain. 
 Continuous learning and personal growth possibilities. 
 International and cross-cultural working environment. 
 Hybrid working model. 
 Office located in the downtown of Helsinki. 
  
 #LI-HYBRID 
 
 Who we are : We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.
 
 How we work : When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
 
 To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here .
 
 As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.
 
 Data Privacy : We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.
 
 Beware of Job Scams: Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees.  These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information.  If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site. 
 
 To all recruitment agencies : Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.
